example_claim: A pre-existing anatomical, pathology-region, compartment or spatial-domain label is spatially credible under matched null controls.
spatial_unit: spot, cell, field-of-view or pathology region; sample or slide is the replication unit when available
minimum_required_controls: within-sample label shuffle; composition-aware or phenotype-preserving shuffle; sample-stratified null when multiple samples exist
optional_strict_controls: block/FOV-aware shuffle; region-stratified null; subsampling sensitivity; topology-only versus composition-only comparison
preserves: coordinates, sample identity, unit count, observed label abundance and nuisance composition structure targeted by the null
breaks: the association between the submitted domain/pathology label and its spatial topology beyond preserved nuisance structure
primary_statistic: observed spatial/topology certificate margin versus matched-null quantile; same-label retrieval AUC when used
certificate_rule: certify only when the observed statistic exceeds the pre-specified matched-null threshold and sensitivity checks do not reverse the verdict
allowed_language: SNRA audits whether a pre-existing spatial domain or pathology-region label remains credible after matched negative controls.
blocked_language: SNRA discovers new pathology regions, replaces pathology review, or proves biological mechanism from domain separation.

example_claim: A lineage-stratified cancer or stromal core-border boundary is robust to phenotype-preserving controls.
spatial_unit: cell-level boundary, compartment, core, border or invasive-margin label within sample/slide
minimum_required_controls: lineage- or phenotype-preserving within-sample label shuffle; compartment abundance-matched null; sample-stratified null
optional_strict_controls: distance-to-boundary matched null; FOV/block-aware null; subsampling sensitivity; leave-one-sample sensitivity
preserves: coordinates, sample identity, lineage/phenotype labels, boundary label counts and broad compartment abundance
breaks: the specific alignment between lineage-restricted boundary labels and spatial/topological boundary structure
primary_statistic: boundary certificate rate and observed-minus-null certificate margin
certificate_rule: certify only the lineage- and boundary-specific claim that passes the matched null; downgrade broad compartment claims that remain positive under controls
allowed_language: SNRA supports a lineage-stratified boundary robustness claim under the stated controls.
blocked_language: The broad tumor microenvironment, four-compartment topology or invasive mechanism is proven by this boundary audit.

example_claim: Two cell phenotypes are spatially co-localized beyond abundance and local-neighborhood nuisance structure.
spatial_unit: cell-level nearest-neighbor graph, local neighborhood or cell-type pair within sample/slide
minimum_required_controls: cell-type abundance-preserving label shuffle; within-sample graph/adjacency control; sample-stratified null
optional_strict_controls: degree- or distance-matched adjacency null; neighborhood-size matched null; phenotype-restricted null; subsampling sensitivity
preserves: cell coordinates, sample identity, graph size, cell-type abundance and nuisance degree/neighborhood structure when specified
breaks: the submitted cell-type-pair spatial adjacency or same-neighborhood enrichment claim
primary_statistic: same-cell-type or same-neighborhood retrieval AUC; observed pair enrichment versus matched-null quantile
certificate_rule: certify only association or co-localization language when pair-level statistics exceed matched-null thresholds across samples
allowed_language: SNRA audits cell-type co-localization or neighborhood enrichment as a spatial association claim.
blocked_language: Co-localization proves direct interaction, ligand-receptor signaling, causal communication or mechanism.

example_claim: A region, boundary or label differs in cell-type composition while separating composition from topology-specific evidence.
spatial_unit: region, domain, compartment, boundary, spot group or sample-level aggregate
minimum_required_controls: composition-only baseline; phenotype or marker-proxy abundance preservation; sample-stratified comparison
optional_strict_controls: pseudobulk by sample/donor; block-aware composition null; alternative marker-proxy definitions; leave-one-sample sensitivity
preserves: sample identity, region sizes, cell/spot counts and measured or proxy composition features
breaks: the claim that topology adds evidence beyond composition or that composition alone explains the spatial label
primary_statistic: composition-only distance or enrichment score; topology-plus-composition improvement over composition-only baseline
certificate_rule: use composition enrichment as descriptive support unless topology-specific improvement survives matched controls
allowed_language: The audited label is associated with composition differences; topology-specific claims require additional matched-null support.
blocked_language: Composition enrichment alone proves a spatial niche, transcriptional state, causal process or cell-cell interaction.

example_claim: An upstream package endpoint remains positive, or fails, under SNRA-style negative-control stress tests.
spatial_unit: package-derived domain, neighborhood, enrichment endpoint, embedding-label alignment endpoint or sample-level package summary
minimum_required_controls: endpoint-specific within-sample label shuffle; composition-aware or spatial-block negative control; sample-level aggregation of endpoint calls
optional_strict_controls: native endpoint rerun where feasible; fixed-version container; 99-permutation stress test; adapter scope audit
preserves: package input geometry, sample identity, endpoint-specific nuisance structure and control-specific abundance or block structure
breaks: the interpretation that a positive endpoint call is automatically calibrated evidence for the manuscript claim
primary_statistic: positive-call rate under observed data and negative controls; endpoint calibration or stress-failure rate
certificate_rule: describe package endpoints as calibrated, unstable or adapter-bounded according to their behavior under the defined controls
allowed_language: SNRA evaluates package endpoint calibration under defined matched negative-control stress tests.
blocked_language: SNRA proves global superiority over Squidpy, CellCharter, SpaceFlow or other spatial analysis packages.

example_claim: A sender-receiver ligand-receptor pair or pathway represents spatial cell-cell communication.
spatial_unit: sender cell type, receiver cell type, spatial adjacency edge, ligand-receptor pair and sample/slide
minimum_required_controls: not implemented in SNRA v1.0; would require sender/receiver abundance controls, adjacency controls, ligand/receptor expression filters and LR-decoy controls
optional_strict_controls: database-degree matched decoy LR pairs; expression-matched LR decoys; tissue-region stratified adjacency null; perturbation or orthogonal validation
preserves: for future work, coordinates, sample identity, sender/receiver abundance, adjacency degree, LR database degree and expression level distributions
breaks: for future work, the specific LR-pair communication interpretation beyond abundance, adjacency, expression and database-degree nuisance structure
primary_statistic: excluded in v1.0; no SNRA LR certificate statistic is implemented locally
certificate_rule: no v1.0 certificate is allowed; LR can appear only as excluded or future-scope limitation language
allowed_language: SNRA v1.0 can audit spatial proximity or domain credibility, but LR-specific communication auditing is excluded from implemented scope.
blocked_language: SNRA v1.0 certifies ligand-receptor communication, cell-cell signaling or signaling mechanism claims.

example_claim: A gene or gene program is spatially variable or domain-specific beyond spatial and composition confounding.
spatial_unit: gene, gene program, spot/cell expression unit, spatial domain and sample/slide
minimum_required_controls: not implemented in SNRA v1.0; would require expression-level, library-size, domain-size and spatial autocorrelation controls
optional_strict_controls: gene-set size matched decoys; expression-abundance matched gene decoys; domain-label permutation; platform-specific normalization sensitivity
preserves: for future work, coordinates, sample identity, expression distribution, gene-set size, library-size structure and domain abundance
breaks: for future work, the association between a submitted gene/program score and spatial domain or topology beyond expression nuisance structure
primary_statistic: future scope; no v1.0 SVG/program certificate statistic is implemented locally
certificate_rule: do not certify SVG or spatial program claims in v1.0; cite SVG benchmarks only as background motivation
allowed_language: SNRA v1.0 is motivated by spatial-output benchmarking literature but does not implement SVG or spatial-program certification.
blocked_language: SNRA v1.0 detects spatially variable genes, certifies spatial gene programs or validates domain-specific expression mechanisms.

example_claim: A spatial certificate, boundary behavior or package endpoint pattern is reproducible across samples, slides or donors.
spatial_unit: sample, slide, donor, patient or cohort-level aggregate; cells/spots are nested units
minimum_required_controls: sample-stratified null; per-sample certificate summary; donor/sample-aware aggregation; avoid cell-level-only inference for donor-level claims
optional_strict_controls: leave-one-donor sensitivity; random-effects or sample-level meta-analysis; batch/platform-stratified sensitivity; pseudobulk where expression claims are made
preserves: sample or donor identity, nested unit structure, sample-level label abundance and platform/batch strata when available
breaks: the claim that apparent cell/spot-level signal alone is sufficient evidence for sample-, donor- or cohort-level reproducibility
primary_statistic: sample-level certificate rate, per-sample margin distribution, leave-one-sample stability and confidence interval
certificate_rule: make comparative or reproducibility claims only when sample-level summaries support them and no single sample/FOV dominates the result
allowed_language: SNRA reports sample-aware robustness or reproducibility of a bounded audited claim.
blocked_language: Cell-level positives alone establish patient-level, donor-level, prognostic or clinical generality.
